Question: What did Trump mean when he urged Christians to vote, saying: 'You won't have to do it again'? End of democracy or is he going to fix everything or is he just desperate and knows he is going to lose to Kamala Harris without every evangelical vote?
Answer: The most harmless interpretation is that he means to adhere to the two-term rule, so he’s saying, vote for me this time, you won’t be able to vote for me again because this will be my second term, and I don’t care whether you ever vote again or who succeeds me because all I care about is my own ambition. Question: What is the origin of the word 'hospital'? What does it really mean linguistically?
Answer: Related to host, hospitable, hotel and hostelry, a welcoming place to stay. What we now call hospitals used to be called infirmaries (places for the infirm), and iirc a hospital used to be what we would now call a nursing home.

Question: Do all birds lay eggs? If not, which ones don't lay eggs and how did this trait evolve in those species (if it did)?
Answer: All modern birds lay eggs, and as far as we know so did all extinct birds. Laying eggs means they don’t have to carry the weight of a pregnancy as they fly, and even for flightless birds, laying eggs doesn’t have any strong disadvantages which might lead them to evolve to be ovo-viviparous (retaining the egg inside the body and then giving live birth) instead. It is quite possible, however, that in the far future a penguin or auk might evolve to be ovoviviparous, just as the ichthyosaurs did. It would enable them to become wholly aquatic and give birth in the water, instead of having to come ashore to nest. Or the ones that live in the tropics might evolve to do the turtle thing: crawl up the beach for an hour a year, lay their eggs in the hot sand and then abandon them.

Question: If James Potter and the other Marauders had been present for Mulciber's attempted attack on Mary McDonald (which Snape dismissed as a laugh), how would they have responded?
Answer: What attack? All we’re told is that Muciber either tried, or pretended to try (that isn’t clear), to use a Dark spell against Mary. We aren’t told the circumstances: whether he was attacking her, defending himself from her, duelling her or cheating at Quidditch. The idea that it was an attack is your personal fanfiction. All we know about it is that Snape wasn’t present, and was going by what Mulciber had told him, which may or may not have been accurate. We don’t know whether he said it was a laugh because “It was Dark, but it was funny” or because “He was just pretending”. We do know that Mulciber, or at least *a* Mulciber, was later famous for using Imperius, so it’s possible he tried to Imperio Mary. If he did, that would automatically be sinister, but it could have been anything from attempted rape (which would be no worse than the date-rape drugs the Twins sell) to ordering her to quack like a duck, or to let him copy her homework. We just don’t know;.
